title: Of Beasts and Wild Things
description: Of beasts and wild things is a mod that adds many new animals to your world, such as Swan, Deer, Pheasant and Snail!
body:
-----

Of Beasts and Wild Things

This mod adds new animals such as the swan, pheasant, deer and snail


You will find the pheasants in plains, forests, taigas, savanna and meadows.
Whereas deers are found in forests, taigas, dark forest, pale garden and grove.
Swans live near rivers & forests and snails spawns in swamps and forests biomes as well. This mod is recommended and designed to be played alongside the Middle-earth project, which you can find here. ----- ## Credits
